articles.title: New sparkling drinks challenge conventional wisdom on sugar content
articles.summary: A new trend in the beverage market is emerging, favoring drinks with natural ingredients and moderate amounts of sugar over artificial sweeteners or extreme calorie restriction.
articles.content: A new wave is sweeping through the world of sparkling drinks, challenging the conventional wisdom that zero sugar is always better. In the past few months, a multitude of bubbly beverages have flooded the market, all boasting a touch of sugar instead of artificial sweeteners or no sugar at all. Some of these drinks are reimagining classic seltzer water and soda pops, while others are drawing inspiration from heritage libations like switchel and agua fresca - resulting in refreshingly unique flavors. The trend is characterized by the use of real ingredients in moderation, rather than relying on artificial sweeteners or extreme calorie restriction. Griffin Owens and Marcus Klein, co-founders behind Yuzuco, attribute this shift to changing consumer preferences. According to Klein, "Until recently, better-for-you meant no compromise." Consumers wanted products that were not only healthy but also delicious, without sacrificing any of the good stuff. For Yuzuco, the key ingredient is yuzu, a Japanese citrus fruit that shines in its canned sparkling drinks. The beverage is made with water, cold-pressed yuzu juice, and a few functional minerals, resulting in a tangy 9-calorie drink with just 1 gram of sugar due to the natural sweetness of the yuzu. The use of natural ingredients like yuzu juice sets Yuzuco apart from other sparkling drinks on the market. Unlike many zero-sugar options that can taste artificial or overly sweet, Yuzuco's products strike a perfect balance between sweet and sour flavors. Shoppers are increasingly seeking out drinks that use recognizable ingredients, rather than relying on artificial sweeteners or obscure natural alternatives. This shift in consumer preferences has led companies to prioritize using real ingredients in their products. As a result, several brands have begun incorporating actual fruit juice and honey into their sparkling drinks. For instance, Bawi's Agua Frescas offer effervescent twists on traditional Mexican flavors like passion fruit, pineapple, and guava, all made with real fruit juice. Similarly, Walker Brothers' Forest Waters bottle wild-harvested botanicals that are sweetened with a touch of wildflower honey. The trend is not limited to these specific brands, as several companies have launched products that emphasize the use of recognizable ingredients. Tractor Beverage Co., for example, recently introduced its canned version of switchel, a zesty farmer's tonic made from ginger and apple cider vinegar. The company's chief brand officer and head of product, Duke Stump, notes that it is essential to use "kitchen ingredients" in their products. By prioritizing the use of real ingredients, these companies are betting on the idea that consumers will respond positively to more transparent and familiar flavor profiles. This approach stands out from other zero-sugar options, which can often taste artificial or overly sweet. The trend towards zero-sugar sparkling drinks has shifted as consumers now crave a touch of sweetness in their bubbly beverages. This change in preference is evident in the market, where manufacturers are opting for natural sweeteners over artificial alternatives. To cater to this demand, beverage brands are revisiting traditional ingredients like molasses and maple syrup to add depth and richness to their products without overpowering them with excessive sugar content. Fruit juice is another popular choice, offering a more nuanced sweetness that complements the flavors of other ingredients. The inclusion of honey in certain sparkling drinks has proven particularly effective in achieving this balance. articles.summary: The overhaul introduces 30 new or enhanced features designed to simplify and enhance the travel experience for Expedia users.
articles.content: Expedia Group has unveiled a comprehensive overhaul of its travel services, introducing 30 new or enhanced features designed to simplify and enhance the entire travel experience. The revamped platform promises easier payment options, AI-driven search functionality, and improved itinerary planning tools, all aimed at making travel more accessible and stress-free for users. This latest update builds on previous enhancements, including a loyalty program perk that grants lounge access to certain members when flights are delayed. One Key Gold and Platinum members can now enjoy free lounge access, regardless of airline, for themselves and up to nine companions when their flight is delayed by 90 minutes or more. Lounge access is facilitated through the LoungeKey Network, which operates several high-end airport lounges worldwide. These benefits apply to qualifying flights booked via Expedia by December 31, 2027, while all One Key members also receive a discounted CLEAR+ membership, with savings varying according to their elite status. Expedia has introduced a new feature for One Key Gold and Platinum members called "One Key Price Drop Protection." This program automatically provides the difference in One KeyCash if the price of a qualifying flight drops before departure. The benefit is only available for flights that show "Price Drop Protection during booking, ensuring users know which options qualify. This added security gives travelers peace of mind when planning their trips and can help them save money on their travel expenses. Vrbo, Expedia's home rental platform, has also improved its services with the introduction of Reserve Now, Pay Later. This feature allows guests to reserve eligible homes without paying upfront costs at booking. However, a card must be on file for this option to be available. This new policy provides group planners with more flexibility when confirming who is coming and managing the cost of their stay. It also gives travelers more freedom to plan their trips without worrying about upfront expenses. Hotels.com has enhanced its AI comparison feature, providing users with personalized, plain language comparisons based on their expressed interests. This includes factors such as location, amenities, price, and policy details, allowing travelers to make informed decisions when choosing accommodations. Vrbo's Natural Language Search allows trip planners to use their own words to find specific properties that match their needs. For example, they can search for a beachfront home in Hawaii with a well-stocked kitchen and outdoor gathering space." Expedia has revamped its homepage to provide a more personalized experience for travelers. The refreshed design brings together relevant recommendations, deals, recent activity, and useful next steps in a visually appealing format that responds to users' needs throughout their journey. The company is also relying on technology and personalization to enhance the travel planning process. Its One Key loyalty program has been upgraded to offer elite-like benefits, including lounge access for delayed flights, which can provide instant gratification for casual travelers through discounts or start building towards bigger rewards. Expedia's new features aim to make traveling smoother and more enjoyable, with a focus on providing relevant information and benefits at every stage of the journey. articles.title: Ke Huy Quan Resurgence in Hollywood After 20-Year Hiatus
articles.summary: Ke Huy Quan's resurgence into Hollywood is a remarkable story of perseverance and talent. The Vietnam-born actor first made waves with his breakout roles in Indiana Jones and the Temple of...
articles.content: Ke Huy Quan's resurgence into Hollywood is a remarkable story of perseverance and talent. The Vietnam-born actor first made waves with his breakout roles in Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom and The Goonies in the 1980s. However, as the decade transitioned to the 1990s, Quan found himself struggling to secure significant acting opportunities despite having two major hits on his resume. His film roles became increasingly minor, and he began to appear in TV bit-parts instead. In a bid to stay relevant within the industry, Quan stepped away from acting in 2002 to pursue a behind-the-scenes career. He started working as an assistant director (AD) and stunt coordinator, a move that allowed him to remain involved in filmmaking while taking on new challenges. Despite his efforts, Quan eventually felt the urge to give acting another shot when he approached 50 years old in the 2020s. This led him to audition for Everything Everywhere All at Once, an unconventional sci-fi fantasy drama that would ultimately revive his career and earn him critical acclaim. The film's massive success catapulted Quan back into the spotlight after a two-decade hiatus, and his performance earned him his first Oscar. His story serves as a testament to the unpredictable nature of the acting industry, where even those who seem to have vanished can still experience a resurgence. Quan's journey is not an isolated incident within the entertainment world. Many actors from the 1990s have struggled to find their footing in the years that followed, with some seemingly disappearing from the public eye altogether. This article will explore the stories of several movie stars who vanished from Hollywood in the 1990s and beyond, shedding light on what led them away from the spotlight and whether they've managed to revive their careers like Quan did. While some actors have been able to bounce back into prominence, others have found it much more challenging to regain their footing within the industry. Their stories offer a glimpse into the highs and lows of an unpredictable profession that can be marked by sudden successes and equally swift downturns. Kate Capshaw's early career was marked by notable roles in several movies and TV shows during the 1990s. Her performances in films such as Just Cause and How to Make an American Quilt showcased her acting abilities. In addition to her work on screen, Capshaw also appeared alongside Harrison Ford and Ke Huy Quan in the 1984 film Temple of Doom. Directed by Steven Spielberg, this movie marked a significant milestone in her career. Capshaw's retirement from acting in the early 2000s allowed her to explore other creative pursuits. She has since become a successful painter, exhibiting her work at prestigious institutions such as the Smithsonian National Portrait Gallery and the Obama Presidential Center in Chicago. Her transition from acting to painting was not an isolated incident; many former actors have successfully pursued careers in the arts after leaving the spotlight. Capshaw's decision to focus on painting may be attributed to her desire for a more stable and fulfilling career. Phoebe Cates, another actress who emerged in the 1980s with notable roles in films like Fast Times at Ridgemont High and Gremlins, struggled to replicate this success in the early 1990s. Her performances in movies such as Drop Dead Fred and Bodies, Rest & Motion were met with lukewarm reception. Cates' last film appearance was in Princess Cariboo, released in 1994, which she starred in alongside her husband Kevin Kline. Following this, she stepped away from acting to focus on raising their two children. In addition to her family obligations, Cates also pursued a career in business. In 2005, she opened a boutique gift store called Blue Tree on Madison Avenue in New York City. This venture marked the beginning of a successful entrepreneurial journey for Cates. The reasons behind these actors' departures from Hollywood are varied and complex. Some, like Capshaw, have found success in other creative pursuits, while others, such as Cates, have turned to business ventures to pursue new passions. Kevin Kline's wife had a successful film career in the 1990s before stepping away to focus on her family. Her last movie was Princess Cariboo, released in 1994, which she made alongside her husband. David Caruso achieved widespread recognition for his role as Detective John Kelly in NYPD Blue during the 1990s. He gained fame from earlier successes in films like First Blood and Twins before landing the role on the ABC police drama. Caruso left NYPD Blue after a few episodes of its second series, reportedly due to a pay dispute. This move led to difficulties for him to capitalize on his success until he returned to television with a lead role in CSI: Miami in 2002. When CSI: Miami ended its run ten years later, Caruso decided to retire from acting altogether and transition into the art world. He has since found success working in this new field. The details of his current projects are not publicly disclosed but he is reportedly thriving. Joan Cusack's impressive film career spans several decades. Her notable role in Working Girl earned her an Oscar nomination in 1988, marking a significant milestone in her career. This early success paved the way for numerous other roles throughout the 1990s. She appeared alongside Kevin Kline in In & Out and had a memorable supporting part in Addams Family Values. Cusack's performances have consistently received critical acclaim. The range of her acting skills and versatility as an actress have contributed to her enduring impact on Hollywood. Throughout her career, Cusack has demonstrated her ability to excel in various genres and roles. Cusack's decision to step away from acting after School of Rock was likely influenced by her desire to focus on raising her children. The gift shop she quietly opened in Chicago, Judy Maxwell Home, seems to have been a labor of love outside of the spotlight. When asked to reprise her role as Jessie in Toy Story 5, Cusack made her first red carpet appearance in over a decade and has since promoted the animated movie on occasion. This marked a significant return to Hollywood for an actress who had largely stepped back from the public eye. Cameron Diaz's decision to retire from acting in the early 2010s was motivated by her desire to focus on her family. The actress, known for starring roles in The Mask and There's Something About Mary, had been absent from the industry for over a decade before making a tentative return with Back in Action in 2025. Diaz's comeback film was aptly titled, given its spy thriller genre and her own experience as an action hero in past films. Shelley Duvall's career spanned six decades, during which she appeared in a wide range of films. Despite earning critical acclaim for some performances, including her role in The Shining, Duvall struggled to find consistent success in the 1990s. Duvall's decision to leave acting was likely influenced by her personal struggles during that period. Her brother's cancer diagnosis at the end of the decade marked a significant turning point in her life. She chose to return home to Texas and adopt a quieter lifestyle. The small town where she settled became a familiar sight for Duvall, who had previously been based in Hollywood. Despite her decision to step away from acting, her experience would eventually lead her back into the spotlight. It wasn't until 2023 that she returned to acting with a role in The Forest Hills, an indie horror flick. Duvall's life took a poignant turn when she passed away in 2024 at the age of 75. This loss came just two years after the Razzie Awards made the rare gesture of rescinding her nomination for The Shining. The honor was bestowed upon her more than four decades after the original nomination. The timing of Duvall's passing served as a poignant reminder of the impact that the Razzie Awards can have on an artist's career and legacy. Despite her personal struggles, Duvall left behind a body of work that continues to be recognized for its quality. Lee Evans' Hollywood debut in the late 1990s was marked by roles in notable films such as The Fifth Element, There's Something About Mary, and Mouse Hunt. With his star rising, Evans took a surprising turn by stepping away from film roles and returning to standup comedy in the UK. Evans' decision proved prescient, as he became one of the first British comics to sell out an arena tour. This achievement marked a significant milestone for him, both personally and professionally. However, his success was short-lived, as Evans eventually retired from standup comedy altogether. At the height of his standup career, Evans transitioned into a new phase of his life, working in theatre and music instead. His decision to retire from comedy allowed him to explore different creative outlets and pursue other passions. Fonda's own acting career was marked by notable roles in films like The Godfather Part III, Single White Female, and Jackie Brown. However, at the height of her success she stepped back from acting to focus on her family and recover from a serious car accident that left her with a fractured vertebra. articles.title: Delta Introduces Two Premium Credit Cards with Exclusive Airline Benefits
articles.summary: The airline has launched two credit cards that cater to different types of travelers, offering various perks and benefits.
articles.content: Delta has introduced two premium credit cards that offer exclusive airline benefits for frequent flyers: the Delta SkyMiles Platinum American Express Card and the Delta SkyMiles Reserve American Express Card. These cards are not cheap to hold onto, but they do come with a range of perks that can make air travel more comfortable and convenient. Choosing between them depends on individual preferences and usage patterns. While both cards offer premium benefits, they cater to different types of travelers. The Delta Platinum card has a lower annual fee of $350 and provides better everyday earning potential. The Delta Reserve card, with an annual fee of $650, offers additional perks that may be more appealing to certain users, such as Sky Club access and faster Medallion status earning. A key consideration when choosing between these cards is whether the added features of the Delta Reserve justify its higher cost. Those who can make use of its extra benefits will find it a worthwhile investment, while others may prefer the lower annual fee of the Platinum card. Delta Platinum cardholders can enjoy a range of benefits including supermarket purchases as part of their rewards program. The Delta Reserve credit card offers more premium-cabin flexibility through its companion certificate, making it an attractive option for travelers who want to upgrade their travel experience. In terms of welcome offers, both cards have currently compelling deals. The Delta SkyMiles Platinum card is offering a bonus of up to 90,000 miles plus a $300 statement credit after spending $4,000 on purchases within the first six months of membership. The offer for the Delta Reserve card is slightly lower, but still attractive, with 50,000 bonus miles available after spending $10,000 in the same timeframe. Other restrictions apply to both offers, including a 21+ day advance purchase requirement and taxes and fees up to $80 per person. Delta Platinum offers more flexible benefits compared to its premium counterpart, the Delta Reserve card. One of the key advantages of the Delta Platinum card is its ability to offer miles as a reward option, which may be more appealing to those who value flexibility in their travel rewards. In contrast, the Delta Reserve card's offer requires more card spending and has less flexible redemption options. This makes the Delta Platinum card a more attractive option for those looking to earn or redeem miles on their preferred routes. Travelers who can only justify booking a lower-tier Delta ticket may still benefit from either card's perks. For solo travelers, however, a companion certificate in any cabin may not be as valuable due to its limitations. In terms of lounge access, the Delta Reserve card offers more comprehensive benefits for those who frequent Sky Clubs or Amex Centurion Lounges. Delta Sky Club members with the Reserve card can enjoy 15 visits per Medallion year on same-day Delta-marketed flights, unless they spend at least $75,000 annually, in which case access becomes unlimited. The Delta Platinum card offers a more affordable route to saving on bags and boosting SkyMiles balances for those who don't need high-end perks. For travelers prioritizing everyday rewards over luxury benefits, this card provides a solid value proposition. However, the Delta Reserve card shines for individuals who frequently utilize Sky Clubs and redeem companion certificates for premium travel. In such cases, the higher annual fee becomes more justifiable due to enhanced access to exclusive airport lounges and other travel benefits. One area where both cards level out is in earning miles on eligible Delta purchases, with each offering 3 miles per dollar spent. Yet, this parity masks a crucial difference: despite its steeper annual fee, the Reserve card doesn't accelerate SkyMiles accumulation when buying Delta airfare. In contrast, the Platinum card rewards several everyday spending categories, allowing users to earn miles faster than their Reserve counterparts. This disparity makes the Platinum an attractive option for those focused on earning miles through routine purchases rather than travel benefits alone. While both cards offer MQD Headstart benefits at the start of each Medallion Qualification year, the Delta Platinum's accelerated earnings from everyday rewards give it a notable edge in this regard. The Delta Platinum card offers more opportunities to earn Medallion Qualification Dollars (MQDs) than its Reserve counterpart, but at a potential cost in redeemable miles. For every $20 spent on supermarket purchases, for example, the Platinum card earns 500 MQDs compared to just 1,000 MQDs earned by the Reserve card. This disparity could be significant for those close to reaching the next Medallion tier. While faster status progress may be appealing, it's essential to consider whether earning status through credit card spending is truly necessary. If you're already near the next threshold or can achieve status through other means, choosing the Reserve card over the Platinum might not be justifiable. Ultimately, the Delta Platinum card offers a more comprehensive range of earning opportunities, making it the better choice unless MQDs are a top priority for your travel plans. articles.title: Wildfires release toxic heavy metals into urban air pollution
articles.summary: Los Angeles residents faced an unprecedented health crisis during the 2025 fires when toxic heavy metals from smoke polluted the air.
articles.content: Los Angeles residents faced an unprecedented health crisis during the 2025 fires when toxic heavy metals from smoke polluted the air. Researchers at the California Institute of Technology analyzed the chemical makeup of smoke from the Eaton Fire and compared it to that of a traditional wildfire. Their findings revealed striking differences in the composition of urban and natural fire plumes, with significant amounts of lead, arsenic, and halogens present in the former. The study's authors attribute this disparity to the presence of burning vehicles, building materials, and electronics in urban areas, which release toxic chemicals into the air when they burn. This contamination is thought to have a profound impact on air quality and human health during wildfires in cities like Los Angeles. Airborne lead concentrations surged to alarming levels during the peak of the 2025 fires, exceeding normal background levels by as much as 80 times over a 24-hour period, putting millions of residents at risk. The chemical composition of wildfire smoke is a crucial aspect that researchers have been trying to understand for some time now. Co-author Haroula Baliaka points out that knowing the differences in smoke composition between urban and wildland fires can help bridge the gap in existing research. Wildfires are becoming increasingly frequent, intense, and destructive due to climate change, which has led to drier and warmer weather conditions. As cities expand and more wildfires encroach on urban areas, researchers warn that monitoring and emergency response systems will need to adapt to these new challenges. Professor Ed Avol, an expert in the health effects of air pollution, notes that significant exposure to heavy metals is consistent with what he would expect from such a disaster. However, he finds it surprising that this level of metal exposure has not been previously documented. One of the key strengths of this study lies in its ability to make detailed measurements of airborne pollutants on an hourly basis across the sampling network. This level of data collection is typically rare and often limited to weekly or bi-weekly intervals. The devastating wildfires in Altadena and the Pacific Palisades, which broke out on January 7, 2025, had a profound impact on the affected communities. The fires claimed at least 31 lives and destroyed over 16,000 structures, including homes, cars, furniture, and other household items. Millions of people were exposed to toxic smoke from these wildfires, with long-term health consequences already linked to similar events in the past. A recent study found that metal mixtures in leftover debris from another major wildfire had a detrimental effect on lung health for those living nearby. Researchers used a network of air quality monitors across the US to measure the chemical composition of fine particulate matter in real-time during the LA fires. This network, known as ASCENT, is a relatively new system that can track the size and chemical makeup of airborne particles every hour. By analyzing the data from ASCENT, researchers were able to identify the specific chemicals present in the smoke and how their concentrations changed over time. They also used this information to distinguish between emissions coming from burning structures and other sources. In comparison with a 2024 fire in Riverside County that burned mostly vegetation, the LA wildfire plume contained significantly higher levels of toxic heavy metals. Specifically, it had 50 times more lead, three times more arsenic, and seven times more halogens than the Riverside County fire. The data from ASCENT allowed researchers to estimate the number of people exposed to these high levels of pollution during the peak of burning. At this time, approximately 7 million people were exposed to lead levels that were more than 80 times higher than typical for a 24-hour period. The toxic effects of lead on human health are well-documented, with potential impacts including stunted child development, lower IQ scores, and increased blood pressure in adults. Despite its widespread presence in urban environments, scientists still do not fully understand the long-term consequences of short-term exposure to high levels of lead. Researchers have also linked arsenic exposure to various types of cancer, highlighting the need for continued study into the health effects of air pollution from wildfires. According to Dr. Yaguang Wei, an expert in environmental medicine, the findings of this study reinforce his own research on the toxicity of PM2.5 particulates from wildfire smoke compared to other sources. The study's findings highlight the need for caution when it comes to exposure to wildfire smoke. The toxic heavy metals present in PM2.5 particulates pose a significant health risk, particularly for vulnerable populations. To mitigate this risk, experts recommend taking steps to minimize exposure to these pollutants. This can be achieved by implementing measures such as improving air filtration systems and reducing the use of materials containing toxic substances in homes. articles.title: Travel Accessories Key to Stress-Free Journey
articles.summary: A good tote bag, toiletry bag, and leakproof travel bottles are essential items for travelers.
articles.content: Traveling can be a daunting experience, but having the right gear can make all the difference in ensuring a seamless journey. Whether you're embarking on a domestic or international trip, being prepared with smart gadgets and accessories is crucial for a stress-free travel experience. For those who have been around the block a few times, it's clear that certain essentials are worth bringing along to make long-haul flights more manageable. After years of testing various travel accessories, a list of must-haves has emerged that can elevate any trip from chaotic to comfortable. At its core, these travel accessories focus on comfort, organization, and safety, the holy trinity of stress-free travel. One of the most valuable items in this arsenal is a good tote bag, which serves as both personal item and storage container for all in-flight essentials. A quality tote bag should feature comfortable shoulder straps, secure closure options, and multiple interior pockets to keep valuables within easy reach. A good toiletry bag is essential for any traveler, as it keeps products organized and prevents spills that can damage luggage or ruin clothing. Dagne Dover and Away offer smaller options that are perfect for carrying skincare essentials without taking up too much space in your suitcase. For longer journeys, a hanging toiletry bag can be a game-changer. Bagsmart's option is designed to hook onto the back of the bathroom door at the hotel, keeping the counter clutter-free and making it easy to find what you need. Peak Design's wash pouch has been a best-seller for years, and its durability speaks for itself. Commerce director Madison Flager has used hers for over five years and it still looks like new. When packing valuables, never check them in your luggage. A jewelry case is essential for keeping necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and rings safe and organized. Mark and Graham's jewelry case is on the larger side, making it ideal for destination weddings or special events where you may need to bring multiple pieces of jewelry. Leakproof travel bottles are a great alternative to buying plastic minis every time you travel. They can hold your at-home favorites in refillable containers that aren't bulky in your toiletry bag. Travelers often underestimate the importance of organization when it comes to their personal care items during trips. A well-planned pill case can make a significant difference in managing medication, particularly for longer journeys. Dosey's seven-day pill case stands out for its compact design and attractive appearance. This makes it an ideal choice for week-long trips, as it can be easily stored on hotel bathroom counters without taking up too much space. A good makeup bag is essential for keeping beauty products organized and secure during travel. Afform's makeup bag has gained a loyal following due to its innovative foldable design, which allows users to access their products with ease. The standout feature of this makeup bag is its ability to keep each product upright and secure, reducing the risk of spills or damage. Its structured silhouette and flat base provide stability, making it perfect for carrying breakable items like pricey skincare products. For those on a budget, Eachy's best-selling makeup bag offers excellent value with its spacious design and multiple compartments. This makes it an ideal choice for carrying full-size blushes and bronzers, as well as smaller products like eyeshadow palettes. Traveling with makeup brushes can be challenging, especially when they're packed in a cosmetic pouch. This often leads to a messy situation, where other products are covered in powder or bronzer residue. A dedicated brush holder has made all the difference for one traveler, who now stores their brushes flat in the same direction, keeping them organized and away from other products. The $15 Amazon find is large enough to hold several brushes and features a magnetic flap to keep them secure. A travel wallet can greatly reduce the stress of traveling by limiting the number of cards and cash you need to carry. Bellroy's RFID-blocking wallet is a practical choice for travelers as it safeguards against identity theft while also keeping your essentials organized. Coach's sleek leather card holder is another great option that fits easily into even the smallest purses, making it perfect for those who prefer a more minimalist approach. Travel wallets can be especially useful on trips where you're likely to lose or have items stolen, such as when visiting crowded tourist destinations. When choosing a travel wallet, consider one made from high-quality materials that will withstand regular use and won't compromise your valuables. A slim design is also essential for minimizing bulk while maximizing storage space for the essentials like cards, cash, and identification documents. Travel wallets can be easily replaced if lost or stolen, making them an ideal choice for those who want to minimize their travel stress levels. When packing for a trip, it's easy to overlook the smaller items that can make a big difference in comfort and convenience during travel. One often-overlooked accessory is a hat clip, which can be used to hang hats from personal items or suitcases without taking up valuable space. A good hat clip should be compact and lightweight, making it easy to stow away when not in use. Chubb recommends the Toptote, which fits easily into the palm of your hand and features a simple design that secures hats with magnets. Another essential item for long trips is an eye mask, designed to provide total darkness and stay in place even during turbulence. Amazon offers a range of options, including 100% silk masks from Zimasilk and soft, sculpted masks from MZoo that mold to fit individual faces. Travel pillows are also crucial for comfort during flights or other long journeys. They come in various styles and materials, but top recommendations include Cabeau's Evolution S3 and Ostrichpillow's Go memory foam pillow, both of which offer great head and neck support. While not strictly necessary, a pair of foldable slippers can add a touch of luxury to an otherwise cramped flight. Lightweight and compact, these slippers can be easily stowed away when not in use, making them ideal for travelers who want to stay comfortable without taking up too much space. For those who tend to get chilly during flights, a travel blanket is a worthwhile investment. Look for something lightweight that can be packed into a small pouch when not in use, providing warmth and comfort during long journeys. Travel blankets are particularly useful on red-eye flights, where they may even help travelers catch some shut-eye. With so many options available, it's easy to find the perfect travel blanket to suit individual needs and preferences. Travelers often overlook the importance of comfort accessories when preparing for a long journey. Compression socks are a simple yet effective solution to alleviate the discomfort that comes from sitting still for extended periods. Bombas and Comrad offer high-quality compression socks that stay in place and help reduce swelling, making them ideal for long-haul flights or road trips. These brands have gained popularity among travelers due to their comfort and effectiveness. A well-stocked skincare routine can be a luxury not everyone has time for while traveling, but some essential products can make all the difference. Summer Friday's Jet Lag mist is a popular choice for providing a quick dose of hydration before or after takeoff. For more intense moisturizing needs, Dieux's lipid-rich face moisturizer is recommended by commerce producer ElleAnna Revell. This product provides long-lasting hydration and helps to combat dry skin. Travelers often forget about the importance of hand care during their journeys. A shea butter cream can be a simple yet effective solution for keeping hands hydrated and soft. For those looking to upgrade their in-flight experience, eye patches are a worthwhile investment. Peter Thomas Roth's eye patches offer excellent hydration and brightening benefits, while Rhode's patches provide a secure fit that stays in place even during turbulence. articles.title: Airfare Prices Surge 71% at Frontier Airlines in Recent Months
articles.summary: The increase in ticket prices is largely attributed to high jet fuel costs, which have been a challenge for the global airline sector over the past seven months.
articles.content: Airfare prices have skyrocketed for passengers flying with budget airlines like Frontier Airlines in recent months. The airline revealed that its ticket prices have surged by a whopping 71% between July and September compared to the same period last year. The increase is largely attributed to high jet fuel costs, which have been a persistent challenge for the global airline sector over the past seven months. Airlines have responded by passing on these increased expenses to customers in the form of higher ticket prices. This trend has been evident across the industry, with many airlines adopting similar pricing strategies. Frontier's CEO James Dempsey acknowledged the role of high oil prices in driving up airfare costs during a recent earnings call. However, he also attributed a significant portion of the airline's revenue surge to other factors. Dempsey noted that the collapse of Spirit Airlines earlier this year has given Frontier a competitive advantage and allowed it to implement more sophisticated pricing strategies. The impact of these changes is evident in Frontier's quarterly filing, which shows a substantial increase in base fares paid by passengers between July and September. The airline's revenue growth can be attributed to a combination of factors, including the shift towards higher-priced tickets and the airline's improved competitiveness. Frontier's decision to raise ticket prices has been met with frustration from customers who are already feeling pinched by high airfare costs. As the airline continues to navigate the challenges posed by high jet fuel prices and increased competition, it remains to be seen how these changes will affect the industry as a whole. The disappearance of Spirit Airlines from the market has had a significant impact on industry pricing, particularly for budget carriers that rely on competing on low fares. Analysts have noted that Frontier Airlines is one of the major beneficiaries of Spirit's collapse, with the airline seeing improved revenue management as a result. Frontier's ability to fill more seats and charge higher prices has been facilitated by its expansion into routes previously flown by Spirit, with the two carriers having overlapped on about 30% of their routes before Spirit went out of business. The airline has since added numerous new routes, and is likely to continue expanding into areas where it can capitalize on the loss of its former rival. In addition to Frontier's growth, industrywide ticket prices have surged, with September fares up roughly 22% over last year. The recent surge in airfare prices shows no signs of abating, especially during peak travel seasons like Thanksgiving. According to Cirium's data, holiday fares have increased by approximately 30% compared to last year. Airlines are likely to maintain higher prices even after oil costs decline, as executives from major carriers believe they can sustain the revenue generated from these increased rates. Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian recently stated that fuel price reductions will not necessarily lead to lower airfares. Airline executives seem convinced that passengers are willing to pay more for flights, which has enabled them to charge higher prices. This trend is evident in Frontier's operations, where planes remained relatively full during the third quarter despite slight declines compared to last year. American Airlines has also signaled its intention to prioritize higher fares over filling every seat on its flights. Meanwhile, Frontier reported a significant loss of $104 million in the third quarter due to rising jet fuel costs, which eroded its bottom line despite recording record passenger revenue during that period. The airline's financial struggles are expected to continue until two major premium investments come online next year. These upgrades include new first-class seats, which will likely be available for sale on flights departing by early spring, providing a boost to Frontier's revenue in the coming months. Frontier Airlines is upgrading its in-flight amenities to attract more customers and increase revenue. As part of these upgrades, the airline will offer recliner seats in first class for sale on flights departing early spring. This move aims to appeal to passengers who are willing to pay extra for a more comfortable travel experience. To further enhance the flying experience, Frontier plans to install Starlink Wi-Fi on its aircraft starting early next year. This will be a significant upgrade from the airline's current policy of not offering in-flight internet. The introduction of Starlink Wi-Fi is seen as a major development in the industry, with several carriers already rolling out this technology. The decision to offer Starlink Wi-Fi raises questions about whether Frontier will follow the lead of its competitors and make it available for free to loyalty members. Historically, the airline has charged extra for add-on services, but it remains to be seen if this trend will continue with the introduction of in-flight internet. articles.title: Charges Filed Against Conservative Influencer James O'Keefe and Associate Cam Higby
articles.summary: Conservative influencer James O'Keefe and associate Cam Higby have been charged with serious felony offenses in Minnesota, including unlawful voting and identity theft.
articles.content: Conservative influencer James O'Keefe and his associate Cam Higby have been charged with serious felony offenses in Minnesota. According to a prosecutor's announcement at a news conference, they are accused of using false identities to gain access to polling stations during the state primary election on August 11. The charges against O'Keefe and Higby include unlawful voting and identity theft, which carry significant penalties under Minnesota law. It is alleged that they misrepresented themselves as registered voters in various precincts without permission from the actual voters whose names they used. Prosecutor Mary Moriarty explained that O'Keefe and Higby took advantage of a process called vouching, which allows authorized individuals to verify other voters on Election Day. The investigation into O'Keefe's actions has led to allegations of identity theft as well as unlawful voting. The pair used names of both living and deceased voters, according to Prosecutor Mary Moriarty. This added a new layer of concern to the initial charges. A statement from Minnesota Secretary of State Steve Simon highlighted the potential impact of their actions on public trust in the electoral process. Simon's office alerted the prosecutor's office to O'Keefe and Higby's conduct after it became public knowledge. The misconduct, as described by Simon, was deemed "outrageous and totally unacceptable". O'Keefe and Higby will not be taken into custody but instead will receive a summons to appear in court. Prosecutor Moriarty explained that the pair used a process called vouching to verify other voters on Election Day. The charges against James O'Keefe and his associate have raised questions about voter manipulation in Minnesota. These allegations come amidst claims by former President Donald Trump that Democrats have engaged in widespread voter fraud or rigged elections to their advantage. In an attempt to curb alleged voter fraud, the Trump administration has targeted Democratic-controlled states, seeking access to state voter roll lists and identifying individuals who may not be eligible to vote. The case against O'Keefe is not his first involvement in a controversy surrounding voting rights. In 2024, he faced a lawsuit from a Pennsylvania postmaster after promoting false claims of voter fraud made by a postal worker during the 2020 presidential election. O'Keefe's role at Project Veritas was also scrutinized when he was removed as its head in 2023. Higby, O'Keefe's associate, has a significant online following, with over 285,000 subscribers to his YouTube account. articles.title: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes Film Adaptation Gains Momentum
articles.summary: The highly anticipated film adaptation of The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes is gaining momentum after its release in 2023.
articles.content: The highly anticipated film adaptation of The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes is gaining momentum after its release in 2023. Lionsgate has expressed its excitement for the project, highlighting the creative expertise of author Suzanne Collins. Adam Fogelson, a key figure at Lionsgate, recently praised Collins as a "master storyteller who serves as the company's guiding light in developing this new narrative. The upcoming film promises to captivate fans worldwide with Collins' unique storytelling skills. Her work is marked by exceptional imagination and talent. The Second Quarter Quell, a pivotal event in the Hunger Games series, is central to the story of The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes. This significant occurrence has left an indelible mark on the history of the Games, extending its impact even into the era of Katniss Everdeen a quarter-century later. Recent casting announcements have generated considerable interest among fans and critics alike. Joseph Zada will take on the role of Haymitch Abernathy in the film, a character originally portrayed by Woody Harrelson in the previous Hunger Games movies. Whitney Peak is set to play Lenore Dove Baird, who has a romantic connection with Haymitch. Additional casting updates have been revealed in May 2025, further expanding the talented cast of The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes. Kelvin Harrison Jr. will play Beetee Latier, a notable figure from the 34th Hunger Games and father to Ampert Latier, who participated in the 50th Hunger Games. Maya Hawke has also been announced as Wiress, a District 12 mentor and former champion of the Hunger Games. Lili Taylor has been cast as Mags, another mentor in the upcoming Hunger Games film. This addition joins an impressive lineup of actors and actresses who will bring to life the world of Panem. Ben Wang is set to play Wyatt Callow, a tribute from District 12, adding depth to the story's characters. The casting choices are notable for their ability to capture the essence of each character, bringing authenticity to the film. Ralph Fiennes has taken on the role of President Snow, a position previously held by Donald Sutherland in the original Hunger Games films and Tom Blyth in The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes. His portrayal will undoubtedly be a highlight of the movie. Recent casting announcements include Glenn Close and Billy Porter, who are set to join the cast in June 2025. Their additions bring an exciting dynamic to the film's ensemble cast, further enriching the story. The addition of several key characters to the film has brought new depth and complexity to the story. One such character is Heavensbee, played by Paul Plemons, whose intentions are shrouded in mystery even for his co-star. Plemons himself admitted that he often struggled to understand what motivated Heavensbee's actions, and even questioned how expendable he thought Haymitch was. However, as the story unfolds, it becomes clear that a genuine bond develops between Heavensbee and Haymitch. The film's fans have also played a significant role in shaping its cast, with Elizabeth Fanning landing the role of Effie after a concerted campaign by supporters. The studio ultimately took notice of the fan fervor and offered her the part. Fanning's portrayal of Effie is notable for the curiosity she brings to her interactions with Haymitch. She finds his rough-around-the-edges demeanor intriguing, and their initial meetings are marked by a flirtatious dynamic. Production on The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping has confirmed the return of Jennifer Lawrence and Josh Hutcherson in their iconic roles as Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark. The news was first reported by Deadline in December 2025, but it wasn't until January 2026 that Lawrence addressed speculation about her involvement in the film. In a recent interview, she hinted at possibly reconnecting with director Francis Lawrence for this project. Lawrence's comments on the Happy Sad Confused podcast were followed up by an appearance on Alex Cooper's Call Her Daddy podcast in October 2026, where she confirmed that both she and Hutcherson are indeed reprising their roles. The actress shared her emotional experience of returning to set with familiar faces from the original crew. The highly anticipated film is scheduled for release in November, marking the fifth installment of the beloved franchise. Notably, this will be a second prequel, focusing on protagonist Haymitch Abernathy, who fans remember as Katniss and Peeta's mentor during their games. The upcoming prequel is set to take place 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, specifically on the morning of the Reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell. According to author Suzanne Collins, the story was inspired by David Hume's idea of implicit submission, where he noted that it is easy for the many to be governed by the few. This concept has been a recurring theme in The Hunger Games series, and the prequel will delve deeper into its implications. The official teaser trailer for Sunrise on the Reaping was released in November 2025, giving fans their first glimpse into the world of Panem's past. The trailer hints at the complexities of the characters and the societal pressures that shape them. The full-length trailer, which arrived on April 13, 2026, provides more insight into the story, showcasing Haymitch Abernathy's interactions with President Snow before he takes his place in the arena. Haymitch Abernathy's role in the story takes on a new dimension as he becomes increasingly involved in the growing rebellion against the Capitol. His words of defiance echo through the narrative, reflecting his own emotional turmoil and sense of injustice. I'm sick of living in fear," he declares, highlighting the desperation that has taken hold among the people of Panem. His passion is palpable, foreshadowing a pivotal shift in the story's trajectory. The seeds of revolution are sown as Haymitch becomes one of the key voices urging change. This newfound sense of purpose sets him on a collision course with the Capitol's oppressive regime. articles.title: Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi Designed Statue to be Different Color
articles.summary: The original design for the Statue of Liberty called for it to have a reddish-brown coloration that would last for years.
articles.content: A surprise twist has emerged in the history of one of the world's most iconic landmarks - the Statue of Liberty was originally designed to be a different color from its current copper hue. French sculptor Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi created the statue in 1865 with two distinct goals: to honor the centennial anniversary of the Declaration of Independence and celebrate the strong ties between France and America. This ambitious project brought together some of Europe's most skilled craftsmen, including engineer Alexandre Gustave Eiffel. The construction process was a complex undertaking that required careful planning and execution. Once funding for the massive sculpture was secured, Eiffel played a crucial role in bringing Bartholdi's vision to life. The structure took nearly a decade to complete, with American architect Richard Morris Hunt designing the pedestal on which the statue would stand. As the framework of the Statue of Liberty neared completion in 1884, it was disassembled into 350 individual pieces and packed into 200 crates for shipment across the Atlantic Ocean. These crates arrived safely in New York City in June 1885, setting the stage for the final assembly of this colossal work of art. The Statue of Liberty's copper exterior was a deliberate design choice made by its creator, Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi. This reddish-brown coloration was not just an accident, but rather a feature that was meant to last for years to come. When the statue made its public debut on October 28, 1886, it stood tall at 305 feet and consisted of hundreds of copper sheets, each about two pennies wide. These thin sheets were carefully crafted to provide both durability and flexibility. As the years passed, the Statue of Liberty underwent a transformation, its copper surface gradually darkening to a "darker brown hue" in the 15 years since it was erected in New York Harbor. The oxidation process accelerated in the early 1900s, resulting in a green coating forming on the statue's exterior. This development was not entirely unexpected, as metals naturally react with their environment through a process of corrosion and oxidation. Friedrich August Bartholdi, the designer of Lady Liberty, had actually anticipated that his creation would undergo some degree of color change over time. However, he had predicted a dark red hue, whereas the actual outcome was a green patina. Efforts were made to reverse this transformation, with Congress allocating $62,000 in 1906 for repainting and restoration. The plan was to return the statue to its original copper color, but many saw this proposal as an affront to the monument's integrity. The maintenance costs of regularly repainting the statue were seen as prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, with estimates suggesting that it would need to be recoated every 25 years to prevent the green from reappearing. The Statue of Liberty's transformation from its original copper hue to its signature green color was a gradual process that spanned several decades. By 1910, the statue had already begun to show signs of oxidation, resulting in a mix of copper and greenish blue tones on its surface. Within just 10 years, however, it had fully transitioned into its now-iconic green color. The installation of amber-colored glass panels in the torch by artist Gutzon Borglum in 1916 added an additional layer of visual interest to the statue's design. These panels allowed for internal illumination, which further enhanced the statue's overall appearance. By the 1920s, the Statue of Liberty had largely taken on its modern form and coloration, although it would undergo some minor enhancements in subsequent years. The torch was later wrapped in 24-karat gold leaf and the entire structure was illuminated with floodlights for optimal visibility. The Statue of Liberty's iconic green patina has become synonymous with freedom, but its origins are more complex than one might assume. The copper sheets that make up Lady Liberty's structure were initially a reddish-brown color. Chemical weathering eventually transformed the surface into the distinctive green hue we associate with the statue today, and surprisingly, this process has also provided protection against corrosion. articles.title: Keisha Lance Bottoms vies for governorship of Georgia
articles.summary: Keisha Lance Bottoms is running for governor of Georgia, aiming to become the first woman to hold the office in the United States.
articles.content: Keisha Lance Bottoms is making history as she vies for the governorship of Georgia, a position that would make her the first woman to hold the office in the United States. This milestone is significant not just for Bottoms herself but also for Black women who have long faced barriers in politics. Despite her ambitious goals, Bottoms tends to focus on the policies she would implement as governor rather than the groundbreaking nature of her candidacy. Her personal connection to Georgia is undeniable. As a fifth-generation Georgian, Bottoms' family has deep roots in the state that date back to antebellum times. Her ancestors were once enslaved on a plantation in Crawfordville, and while she rarely discusses this aspect of her heritage explicitly, it undoubtedly plays a role in her desire to serve as governor. Bottoms is facing off against Republican nominee Rick Jackson, a billionaire with a significant advantage in terms of wealth and influence. Despite his claims that Bottoms' tenure as mayor was marked by crime and decline, the former mayor remains committed to her vision for Georgia's future. Atlanta's image as a city plagued by crime and decline is being used as a political tool to discredit Keisha Lance Bottoms' tenure as mayor. However, this narrative has been widely debunked by experts who point out that Atlanta is home to numerous international events, including the Olympics and World Cup soccer matches. In recent ads, Bottoms has pushed back against these claims by highlighting her leadership during the 2020 street protests against police violence in Atlanta and nationwide. The ads feature footage of a news conference she held with law enforcement leaders at the time, where she urged protesters to "go home if they didn't care about the city. The Republican candidate's attacks on Bottoms are not just about her policies, but also about her identity as a Black woman in politics. In a state where all 83 governors since 1776 have been white men, Bottoms' presence is seen as a departure from the norm. Republican coalitions in Georgia rely heavily on suburban and rural areas, where voters often view big cities and their leaders with skepticism. The rhetoric used against Bottoms draws on these biases, tapping into deep-seated concerns about race and gender. Jackson's ads have been particularly effective in using footage of the 2020 protests and violence to paint a negative picture of Bottoms' leadership. The images are grainy and unsettling, but they also serve as a reminder of the real issues that Bottoms faced during her time as mayor. The Republican campaign's attacks on Keisha Lance Bottoms' record as mayor of Atlanta have drawn criticism from some of her supporters, who feel that these criticisms are often based on personal biases rather than a genuine assessment of her qualifications. Retired educator Beverly Rice, a supporter of Bottoms, expressed this sentiment, saying that it is easy for people to attack both Atlanta and its former mayor based on their own prejudices. This criticism suggests that the Republican campaign's efforts may be motivated by factors other than a desire to genuinely evaluate Bottoms' suitability as governor. The nomination of Keisha Lance Bottoms marks the third consecutive time that Georgia Democrats have put forward a Black woman for the state's top office. In 2018 and 2022, Stacey Abrams ran against Republican Governor Brian Kemp but lost both times. Abrams attributed her defeats to various factors, rather than solely blaming her race or gender. Abrams noted that Black women running for governor face a unique challenge in terms of voter expectations. Since there is no precedent for a Black woman holding the office, voters may place an undue emphasis on executive experience when evaluating candidates. This standard, Abrams argued, does not apply equally to all candidates. Stacey Abrams also pointed out that Keisha Lance Bottoms has a strong claim to executive experience due to her time as mayor of Atlanta. Before serving in this role, Bottoms held various positions, including City Council member, magistrate judge, and prosecutor. This diverse background is why some argue that Republicans have been particularly aggressive in criticizing Bottoms' qualifications. As Keisha Lance Bottoms navigates her transition from mayor to a potential governor, some critics are questioning her qualifications for the role. One of the most vocal critics is Democrat Stacey Abrams' opponent in this year's gubernatorial election, Staci Jackson. Jackson has been relentless in his attacks on Bottoms, labeling her as a bad mayor who wouldn't make a good governor. He has repeatedly pointed to Bottoms' decision not to run for re-election as mayor, instead joining the Biden administration as a senior adviser. This move, according to Jackson, was a betrayal of Atlanta's trust. Jackson's campaign has also been fueled by claims that Bottoms allowed Atlanta to burn during her tenure as mayor. This reference is particularly significant in a city known for its resilience and symbolism of rebirth, embodied by the phoenix rising from the ashes. The allusion to the Civil War-era destruction of Atlanta adds an extra layer of weight to these accusations. At recent campaign events, including a rally in Macon, President Trump has echoed Jackson's criticisms, labeling Bottoms as responsible for crime and filth" and "constant riots in Atlanta. The city's reputation has taken a hit in recent years, according to President Trump, who claims that Atlanta is no longer considered a great place. This criticism echoes his 2017 comments on then-U.S. Rep. John Lewis' district, which Trump described as crime-infested" and said was "falling apart". The area includes major corporations such as Delta Airlines and Coca-Cola, as well as the Georgia Institute of Technology. Federal statistics show that Atlanta did experience a crime spike during Bottoms' tenure, but this trend mirrored the nationwide surge in crime during the COVID-19 pandemic. Once the pandemic subsided, both US and Atlanta crime rates declined significantly. Bottoms has also taken heat from Republicans over her handling of bail, with some exaggerating the scope of her executive order blocking the Atlanta jail from holding federal immigration detainees. However, she did sign a city ordinance eliminating cash bail for certain nonviolent crimes to reduce the jail population and what she deemed excessive punishment for minor offenses. Bottoms' campaign emphasizes tangible policy differences, particularly her focus on addressing economic struggles and expanding Medicaid eligibility to reach both urban and rural populations across racial lines. This approach is also reflected in her handling of public safety concerns, where she has shown a balance between toughness and empathy for the realities faced by Black Americans. Her aides believe this portrayal will resonate with voters who want a governor who understands their needs. The campaign's message is that Bottoms should be judged on her policies rather than being defined solely by her racial identity as a Black woman in politics, which can sometimes create barriers to success.
